insights.summary: FY26 revenue was ₹503 Cr (+36%) with EBITDA margin up from 22% to 24% and PAT up 69% to ₹67 Cr; Q4 revenue was a record ₹157 Cr. For FY27 management guided ₹650-700 Cr revenue, ₹100 Cr PAT and 26-27% EBITDA margin, rising to ₹800-850 Cr in FY28 and ₹1,000 Cr at 30% margin in FY29. Growth relies on new registrations in LATAM, MENA and Europe, oncology expansion, a hormone plant from November and 40 bioequivalence products.

what_changed.text: FY27 guidance: ₹650-700 Cr revenue, ₹100 Cr PAT, 26-27% EBITDA margin; FY28 ₹800-850 Cr at 28%
₹1,000 Cr revenue by FY29 at 30% EBITDA margin, excluding hormones and biologics
Alteplase biosimilar dropped (too few trial patients), replaced by Pembrolizumab (Keytruda)
₹50 Cr oncology expansion with three new lyophilisers after EU Annexure 1 rules cut capacity

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: we remain confident of achieving our FY27 goals of INR650 crores in revenue and INR100 crores PAT in FY27

analyst_questions.answer: Q4 annualised already gives ₹650 Cr; CFO said ₹650-700 Cr, with ₹50 Cr upside if registrations come on time.
₹60-70 Cr stuck in Middle East payments during the Hormuz disruption; about 40% recovered, rest by June-July. Debtor days fell to 170, target 150-160.

analyst_questions.topic: Gross margin fell to 44.8% in Q4
analyst_questions.answer: War-related cost increases; expected back to 52-53% once regulated-market sales start from Q2 FY27.
KPMG likely; announcement expected in the next one or two quarters.

red_flags.text: Operating cash flow only about ₹16 Cr in FY26 while receivables rose about ₹130 Cr.
Debtor days still 170 (from 208); Algeria and MENA tender business runs on 100% credit.
Gross margin dropped to about 44.8% in Q4 FY26.
25-30% of revenue from GCC countries exposed to the regional conflict.

watch_next: Q1 FY27 revenue in the ₹150-160 Cr range
First German registrations and regulated-market sales
Collection of the stuck Middle East receivables

business_snapshot.what_they_make: Injectables and oral generics: oncology (including peptides), general injectables, beta-lactam and cephalosporin; building hormone and biosimilar (EPO, Pembrolizumab) units
business_snapshot.customers: Exports through partners and tenders in LATAM (Mexico, Colombia), MENA (Algeria), GCC, Southeast Asia and CIS; small India peptide business
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: FY26 oncology about ₹100-130 Cr of ₹503 Cr; exports roughly MENA 20%, GCC 25%, LATAM 30%, Southeast Asia 10-15%, India 5%
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: New product registrations (55 Mexico submissions), first and second generics of off-patent molecules, regulated-market entry
